‘America’s Got Talent’ judge Heidi Klum tells Fox News Digital it’s ‘no big deal’ that she went topless during her vacation.

Heidi Klum is bringing the heat this autumn in a new poolside snap.

The 53-year-old supermodel turned up the temperature in a new Instagram photo featuring her lounging poolside, wearing nothing but a small pair of black bikini bottoms.

"It’s hot in LA," Klum captioned the post, which shows her lounging topless on a daybed with her dog, with a large grass field and a swimming pool visible behind her.

Fans could not help but compliment the German supermodel in the comments section, with one calling her "greatest super model to ever do it" and another saying she is "Absolutely smoking hot."

HEIDI KLUM DITCHES BIKINI TOP, COVERS UP WITH POTATO CHIP BAG ON BEACH VACATION

Klum shared a photo of herself lounging topless on Instagram. (Heidi Klum Instagram)

A third told her she's "making it hotter" Los Angeles, while another added that the city is "especially" hot "with you there!"

Never one to shy away from posting risqué photos with her fans, Klum previously wished her fans a good morning on Instagram with a photo of her standing outside in semi-sheer white underwear and a multicolored shawl with nothing on underneath.

The shawl left much of Klum's torso exposed, showing off her toned abs and slim figure.

In December 2025, Klum was photographed walking topless on the beach in St. Barts with her husband, Tom Kaulitz.

She previously told Fox News Digital in August 2024, that her European upbringing makes her more comfortable being nude in public, noting, "I grew up… with a lot of nudity… on the beach… for me, this is no big deal."

GET ENTERTAINMENT SCOOP DELIVERED RIGHT TO YOUR EMAIL BY CLICKING HERE

Klum previously shared that her European upbringing makes her more comfortable about nudity. (Gilbert Flores/WWD via Getty Images)

"It's just a very common thing… it's not like I'm doing something, ‘Oh, this is so out of line,’" she said. "And I always go to a beach when there's not a lot of people there… I feel like I'm not… hurting anyone's feelings."

LIKE WHAT YOU'RE READING? CLICK HERE FOR MORE ENTERTAINMENT NEWS

Klum's Halloween party is returning this year, and is celebrating its 25th anniversary. Every year on the spooky holiday, Klum goes all out with her costume, having previously dressed up as Medusa, E.T. from the movie "E.T. the Extra-Terrestrial," an earthworm, Princess Fiona from "Shrek" and other elaborate costumes.

When speaking to People earlier this month, the "Germany's Next Top Model" host shared some clues about her costume this year, saying she thinks hard every year about "how I can one-up myself."

PUT YOUR ENTERTAINMENT KNOWLEDGE TO THE TEST AND SEE HOW YOU SCORE

Klum dressed up as Medusa for Halloween last year. (TheStewartofNY/Getty Images)

"All I can say is that we’re going bigger than ever," she said about this year's costume, noting she "can't wait to celebrate" the "very special milestone" with everyone.

CLICK HERE TO DOWNLOAD THE FOX NEWS APP

"I can’t say too much yet, but I can tell you that this year’s costume is going to be much bloodier than in years past," she shared. "I always love finding a way to surprise people, so I think this one will definitely be gory and get a reaction!"

Lori A. Bashian is an entertainment news writer at Fox News Digital.
